::: {.audience}
For everyone

The guide grows with the app. Each edition is listed here, newest first, with
what's new in it, so you can see what to read again after an update.

## Guide 0.1, for Jholok 0.1

The first edition: the whole app, for people using it for the first time.

- **The ideas behind the app:** stock, units and value (@sec-stock-basics),
  the ledger (@sec-ledger), and counting and checking against it
  (@sec-counting).
- **Everyday use:** setting up the shop and its people (@sec-setting-up), the
  catalogue (@sec-catalogue), recording what comes in and goes out
  (@sec-movements), and the Overview (@sec-overview).
- **Counting:** a count from start to finish (@sec-a-count), counting boxes by
  their tags or a photo (@sec-boxes), and identifying pieces later
  (@sec-identify-later).
- **Checking a count:** book stock (@sec-book-stock), stock off the shelf and
  the cut-off (@sec-cut-off), Review (@sec-review), and the Result and the
  count report (@sec-results).
- **Looking after your shop:** backups and privacy (@sec-keeping-data-safe),
  and stories from a shop's year (@sec-stories).
- The [Questions and answers](questions.qmd) and the [Glossary](glossary.qmd).

It already covers two recent changes to the app:

- **Single earrings.** An earring found without its pair is added with
  **Singles** on the count sheet, beside the pairs, and never changes stock
  (@sec-stock-basics, @sec-a-count).
- **Units kept apart.** The Overview never adds pairs, sets and pieces into
  one number of "items": it gives values, or lists each kind
  (@sec-overview).
